prompt: an event page for a community charity fundraiser, with a date, location, and RSVP form

pages.title: Community Heart Fundraiser – Help Us Make a Difference
pages.html:
❤ Community Heart

Community Heart Fundraiser

Help Us Make a Difference in Our Community

Join us for an evening of celebration, connection, and community support. Together, we can transform lives.

Event Details

📅 When

Saturday, May 18, 2024

6:00 PM – 9:00 PM

📍 Where

Riverside Community Center

842 Oak Street, Springfield, IL 62701

💰 What to Expect

Live music, local food vendors, silent auction, and raffles benefiting local families in crisis.

🎟️ Admission

Free entry. Donations welcome at the door and throughout the event.

Our Mission

Since 2015, Community Heart has been dedicated to supporting local families facing unexpected hardship. Every dollar raised goes directly to emergency relief, housing assistance, and essential services for families in our community who need it most.

This year's fundraiser will directly support 50+ families, helping them rebuild and recover. Your generosity makes immediate, meaningful change possible.

RSVP Today

Let us know you're coming! Register below so we can plan accordingly. Walk-ins are always welcome.

Community Heart Charity

Supporting local families in crisis since 2015

📞 (555) 123-4567 | 📧 hello@communityheart.org
